row.notes: Overflow queue of the audio job worker requests: 24 slots of 0x30 bytes, +0x08 worker fn, +0x24 job type, +0x28 flag (1 = queued), right after the 12 worker mailboxes at 0x146c63bd0. Snd_Request_JobWorker writes the first free slot of all 24 (base lea at 0x143fbddcd, bound 0x4a8 at 0x143fbdde4). Snd_Run_JobWorkerThread reads only slots 0-11 (flag compares 0x143fc65ea..0x143fc66e7, fn and type through the base at 0x143fc6569) and clears a slot's flag under g_Snd_JobWorkerLock when it takes it. No code reads the flags of slots 12-23.

verify.notes: V2184 Blind re-derivation at 177ebc0d. Address, type, layout, sig and the 24-versus-12 claim hold; one label is loose. 24 x 0x30 = 0x480 = 1152 bytes, 0x146c63e10..0x146c64290, right after the 12 mailboxes at 0x146c63bd0 (the worker count at 0x146c64290 and pending at 0x146c64294 follow). Producer Snd_Request_JobWorker: lea rdx 0x146c63e10 at 0x143fbddcd, flag at [rdx+rax] with rax = 0x28 + 0x30*i, i = 0..23 (exit cmp rax,0x4a8 at 0x143fbdde4), writes +0x08 fn, +0x24 type, +0x28 = 1. Consumer Snd_Run_JobWorkerThread: compares exactly 12 flags, 0x146c63e38..0x146c64048 (cmp byte at 0x143fc65ea..0x143fc66e7; lea r13 0x143fc6558 and rbp 0x143fc655f give slots 0 and 1), reads fn and type through lea rdi 0x146c63e10 (0x143fc6566) at index <= 11, clears the flag (0x143fc6711) under the lock. The flags of slots 12-23 (0x146c64078 + 0x30*k) are referenced only by the static init 0x143fcbc30 (byte stores of 0 at 0x143fcc6ef..0x143fcc94c) and by the producer's free-slot scan; the exit dtor 0x143fbdb40 only touches +0x18 of all 24 slots. Loose label: 'No code reads the flags of slots 12-23' should say no consumer reads them, since the producer's free-slot scan (cmp byte [rax+rdx],0 at 0x143fbddec) does. Like the mailboxes, every slot also carries the +0x10 event object (init and dtor), which neither the producer nor the consumer uses for overflow slots.
